_comment: Acceptance questions for the 48-minute, 7-person conversation, written by reading
the transcript by hand before any of the retrieval work landed. They exist so that
'semantic search works' can be checked instead of asserted.
'expect' lists things a correct answer should contain, in substance rather than
wording. 'must_not' lists specific confabulations to watch for. These are for
JUDGING answers, never for tuning retrieval: any code that references them is a bug.
The conversation is gitignored personal data. Keep quotes here short.

checks.why: The broad-scope case with no rankable terms. Every word is a stop word, so relevance ranking alone returns nothing useful; this needs coverage across the whole conversation.
must_not: a single narrow topic presented as the whole conversation

checks.why: Participant recall. Seven people, several introduced mid-conversation.
expect: several of the seven named people
must_not: people who were only mentioned, not present, e.g. Alara, Omer, Ben, Durov, Zelensky

checks.why: A fact stated once, early, by the person himself.

checks.q: Tell me about the Turkish guy's startup.
checks.why: Retrieval by description rather than by name — the user often will not remember the name, which is the entire premise of the product.
expect: named after the Turkish word for cat

checks.why: A person discussed but not present. Must not be added to the participant list.
must_not: described as someone in the room

checks.why: A one-word answer buried in crosstalk, stated in reply to a direct question.

checks.q: Which class is changing its programming language?
checks.why: A specific detail with no proper noun in the question.

checks.q: What did Boris say about his dad?
checks.why: Per-person attribution over a long anecdote. Tests that 'what X said' returns X's own words rather than what was said near X.

checks.q: Who has a sister at Cal Poly?
checks.why: Attribution of a single passing remark to the right speaker — the case most likely to be filed under the wrong person.
expect: a named person, or an honest statement that the speaker is uncertain

checks.q: What did we decide about the ski trip?
checks.why: The control. No ski trip was ever discussed. Refusing must beat inventing, because a confident invented fact about a real friend is the worst failure this product has.
expect: says it does not have this
must_not: any invented detail about a ski trip
